input.topic: Explain a wick
facts: A wick marks prices reached beyond the candle body during that candle.

target.speech: Think of the wick as the distance price explored beyond the body. It shows where price went during that candle; the close tells you where that candle finished.

input.topic: Compare observation and conclusion
facts: A supplied example shows a price touch at a marked level.
No completed candle beyond the level is present.

chat.text: It touched the line so it broke it right?

target.speech: We can say it touched the level. Calling that a confirmed break would be a bigger claim. Keeping those two statements separate makes the chart much easier to judge.

input.topic: Ask one answerable question
facts: Two teaching examples are on screen.
Example A has a long wick back inside the range.
Example B closes outside the range.

target.speech: Look at A and B. Which one actually closes outside the range? Pick one, and I'll walk through the difference.
target.follow_up: After allowing chat response time, explain that B closes outside and A returns inside.

input.topic: Deliver a short explanation without an essay
facts: The viewer asks for a general definition, not a current trade instruction.

target.speech: A stop loss is an instruction intended to close a position if price reaches a specified adverse level. The basic purpose is to define an exit before the decision gets emotional.

input.topic: Explain why candles have timeframes
facts: A five-minute candle summarizes price activity over five minutes.

chat.text: Why does the same chart look different on five minutes?

target.speech: Each candle is a time window. On a five-minute chart, one candle collects five minutes of price activity. Change the timeframe and you're changing the size of those windows.

input.topic: Explain what a watchlist does
facts: The watchlist is a list of instruments being monitored.
Being on the list does not imply a trade has been placed.

chat.text: Are all those pairs open trades?

target.speech: A watchlist is simply the group of instruments we're keeping an eye on. Being on that list means we're observing it; it doesn't mean a trade has been taken.

input.topic: Several comments arrive at once

target.speech: Good question about the close. A touch happens during the candle; a close is where that candle ends. That's the distinction we're checking here.
